mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (knowledge_base_id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, name, description, icon, color, deleted_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{color}, #{deletedFlag}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT kb.*, COUNT(dm.id) AS document_count FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN document_metadata dm ON dm.knowledge_base_id = kb.knowledge_base_id AND dm.tenant_id = kb.tenant_id AND dm.owner_user_id = kb.owner_user_id AND dm.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE kb.deleted_flag = 0 AND kb.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND kb.owner_user_id = #{scope.ownerUserId} GROUP BY kb.id ORDER BY kb.create_time DESC

SELECT kb.*, COUNT(dm.id) AS document_count FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN document_metadata dm ON dm.knowledge_base_id = kb.knowledge_base_id AND dm.tenant_id = kb.tenant_id AND dm.owner_user_id = kb.owner_user_id AND dm.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE kb.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND kb.deleted_flag = 0 AND kb.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND kb.owner_user_id = #{scope.ownerUserId} GROUP BY kb.id
